overall_goal: Perform various kitchen tasks including cleaning, stirring a saucepan, processing mango, and retrieving containers

goals.description: Wash the chopping board and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person rinses the chopping board under the tap, places it in the draining rack, and dries their hands on a towel.

goals.description: Stir the contents of the saucepan and add water from the kettle
goals.rationale: The person removes the saucepan lid, stirs the food, pours in water from the kettle, and replaces the lid.

goals.description: Process mango and handle the blender lid
goals.rationale: The person cuts mango bits, handles mango skin and seeds, and repositions the blender lid on the counter.

goals.description: Clean up the workspace and wipe hands
goals.rationale: The person wipes their hands, places the blender lid back on, and clears the counter by moving the knife, chop board, and chili discard.

goals.description: Store the ice tray and water bottle in the freezer
goals.rationale: The person picks up an ice tray and a bottle of cold water and places them into the freezer.

goals.description: Turn off and detach the blender cup
goals.rationale: The person turns off the blender, detaches the cup, and places it on the counter.

goals.description: Inspect and stir the saucepan while adding water
goals.rationale: The person lifts the saucepan lid to inspect it, stirs the contents, adds water from the kettle, and adjusts the hob's heating level.

goals.description: Retrieve storage containers from the cupboards and drawers
goals.rationale: The person opens various cupboards and drawers to retrieve bowls, tupperware, and a lunchbox.

goals.description: Stir the saucepan and drain excess oil from the food
goals.rationale: The person stirs the saucepan, places the lunchbox on the counter, and then tilts the saucepan to pour out excess oil before wiping its edge.

goals.description: Check the tenderness of the meat in the saucepan and add water
goals.rationale: The person stirs the saucepan, adds water, retrieves a fork to check the meat's tenderness, and then adds more water.
